observed_mechanics: Read the id word at ESP+0x04 into EAX.
Compare EAX against the unsigned dword at this+0x38; JNC (unsigned) diverts to the base path.
Fast path: load this->vtable into EDX, push the id, load vtable slot +0x28 into EAX, and call it with ECX still holding this.
Reload the out pointer from the adjusted stack, store the returned property pointer through it, set AL to 0x1, and return with RET 0x8.
Base path: write the id back to the id stack slot so the callee sees the same argument order, then tail-jump to 0x006a1de0.

observed_original_abi.return_value: 0x1 on the fast path; otherwise the AL produced by the base path
observed_original_abi.signature_caveat: The base path is a tail jump, not a call, so the base routine inherits this receiver, both stack words, and the eight-byte cleanup from this frame.
